mapper.select: SELECT assignment.tenant_id AS tenantId, assignment.template_id AS templateId, template.code AS templateCode, template.name AS templateName, template.description AS templateDescription, assignment.is_default AS defaultTemplate, template.is_enabled AS templateEnabled FROM iam_tenant_column_permission_template_assignment assignment JOIN iam_column_permission_template template ON template.id = assignment.template_id WHERE assignment.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND assignment.deleted_at IS NULL AND template.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY assignment.is_default DESC, template.code

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (resource_column.id) NULL::bigint AS id, template_item.template_id AS templateId, resource_column.id AS resourceColumnId, resource_column.resource_key AS resourceKey, resource_column.column_key AS columnKey, resource_column.column_name AS columnName, template_item.access_mode AS accessMode FROM iam_tenant_column_permission_template_assignment assignment JOIN iam_column_permission_template template ON template.id = assignment.template_id AND template.deleted_at IS NULL AND template.is_enabled = true JOIN iam_column_permission_template_item template_item ON template_item.template_id = template.id AND template_item.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN iam_resource_column resource_column ON resource_column.id = template_item.resource_column_id AND resource_column.deleted_at IS NULL AND resource_column.is_enabled = true WHERE assignment.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND assignment.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY resource_column.id, CASE template_item.access_mode WHEN 'VISIBLE' THEN 3 WHEN 'MASKED' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END DESC, template_item.template_id

SELECT rule.id, rule.tenant_id AS tenantId, rule.role_id AS roleId, resource_column.id AS resourceColumnId, resource_column.resource_key AS resourceKey, resource_column.column_key AS columnKey, resource_column.column_name AS columnName, rule.access_mode AS accessMode FROM iam_role_column_permission_rule rule JOIN iam_resource_column resource_column ON resource_column.id = rule.resource_column_id AND resource_column.deleted_at IS NULL AND resource_column.is_enabled = true WHERE rule.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rule.role_id = #{roleId} AND rule.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY resource_column.resource_key, resource_column.sort_no, resource_column.column_key

UPDATE iam_role_column_permission_rule rule SET deleted_by = #{operator}, delete_reason = 'role-column-permission-rule-outside-tenant-assignment', deleted_at = now(), updated_by = #{operator}, updated_at = now() WHERE rule.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rule.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_tenant_column_permission_template_assignment assignment JOIN iam_column_permission_template template ON template.id = assignment.template_id AND template.deleted_at IS NULL AND template.is_enabled = true JOIN iam_column_permission_template_item template_item ON template_item.template_id = template.id AND template_item.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE assignment.tenant_id = rule.tenant_id AND assignment.deleted_at IS NULL AND template_item.resource_column_id = rule.resource_column_id AND CASE template_item.access_mode WHEN 'VISIBLE' THEN 3 WHEN 'MASKED' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END >= CASE rule.access_mode WHEN 'VISIBLE' THEN 3 WHEN 'MASKED' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END )
